card.fires_on: The middle piece of a long disease name, such as the 'venile' in Juvenile, 'tic' in hemolytic, 'olar' in Bipolar or 'icular' in polyarticular. It appears in lists of indications and patient groups.

modes.label: Juvenile and polyarticular
modes.description: Partway through 'Juvenile' or 'polyarticular' in arthritis or epilepsy headings.

modes.label: Other disease names
modes.description: Partway through words like hemolytic or bipolar after 'patients with'.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long condition name, such as juvenile arthritis or hemolytic anemia, when the word is not yet finished.
